title: 🔆🔅Violating Container Ship with 2,500 Containers Sinks South of the Strait of Hormuz
text:
🔆🔅Violating Container Ship with 2,500 Containers Sinks South of the Strait of Hormuz"

"Public Relations of the IRGC Navy:"

"🔹 A violating container ship attempting to transit an unauthorized and high-risk route in the Strait of Hormuz struck a naval mine, exploded, and caught fire severely."

"🔹 The vessel, carrying over 2,500 containers, sank this morning in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz due to the intensity of the fire."

"🔹 The IRGC Navy announces: Local vessels and fishermen must exercise utmost caution when navigating this route to avoid colliding with containers floating on the water's surface."
